verdict.rationale: GitHub features (issue triage, @gemini-cli on-demand assistance, PR review, rebase/PR automation) suggest a workflow from issue to PR, but there is no explicit evidence of a single end-to-end 'issue → complete PR' capability, and multiple hands-on reports describe the agent getting stuck in loops, failing at basic file edits, and being unreliable for coding tasks, casting doubt on completing such workflows autonomously.
